candidates: Delete commented-out code rather than leaving it in the codebase (in both source and test files). If code is no longer needed after a refactor, remove it entirely; do not retain it as a dead comment.

When refactoring moves or changes the purpose of a code block, update or remove any log messages inside it that no longer accurately describe the surrounding logic. A log message that describes initialization, for example, should not remain inside a function whose role has changed.
In TypeScript files, use type-only import declarations (`import type { Foo } from '...'`) rather than inline type qualifiers inside a mixed import list (`import { type Foo } from '...'`).
